text:
alex: quick sync — we need to pick a prioritized approach for the chat endpoint shape. big ask from customers: keep messages-first ergonomics but accept an optional legacy `prompt` string for compatibility. do we ship a compat shim or separate endpoint?

priya: +1 for shim. customers (integrations team) said they can't do a big migration right away. shim should be opt-in so we don't complicate SDKs for new users. :thumbsup:

mike: question: performance impact? if we accept both, parsing and role-normalization adds overhead. can we quantify tokenization differences before committing? we should have a perf card.

sara: launch criteria proposal (draft):
- support both inputs in the same endpoint behind `compat_mode` flag
- SDKs default to messages-only but expose `compat_mode` for quick migration
- e2e regression suite (10 customer prompts) with quality and latency checks
- telemetry: per-request input_type, role-errors, token-delta
- rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on quality regressions

alex: +1 to those. add: require docs and migration guide before 10% canary. also need product acceptance from solutions eng for top 3 enterprise customers.

priya: also we should decide on role normalization rules now (system/user/assistant). suggestion: preserve explicit roles, but if `prompt` string provided convert it into a single `system` message when `compat_mode=system_prompt`, or into `user` otherwise. document the conversion clearly.

mike: technically doable. need to flag edgecases: tool call markers, function signatures embedded in prompt, and structured output hints — add unit tests for those.

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch `chat-compat-shim` by mike at 2026-03-20T15:12:00Z :rocket:

alex: operational ask: add quota-specific metrics so we can see if compat_mode increases token usage per customer. cost impact is the main objection from infra cost team.

priya: product prioritization: if we can show low perf regression and a migration path, this becomes P0 for customers on Dedicated. otherwise P1 for Hosted. worth scheduling a half-day design sync tomorrow to lock decisions.

mike: I'll scope perf experiment and a minimal shim implementation. target: prototype by end of week.

sara: I'll draft the migration doc and the canary checklist. adding a TODO: define abort thresholds for quality/regression alerts (suggested: >2% fail rate or >20% latency increase).

alex: great. meeting invite incoming. thanks everyone.
